rationale: Round-5 duty: classify my round-4 ask against 0f7f2216 and verify the rewritten invariant comments match the executable flow. CLASSIFICATION: FIXED, verbatim. ReadState's sentinel branch is now `if ctx.DerivationFailed || ctx.Phase == ""` — the exact predicate I specified, mirroring cmd/mindspec/instruct_tail.go:30 — with the latch renamed derivationFailed -> indeterminate and the nil check narrowed accordingly. The consistency property I called for now holds: the identical Context shape (multi-active-spec ambiguity, Phase "" with DerivationFailed false) gets the same honesty answer from the hook (ModeIndeterminate, non-nil) that instruct_tail gives it (indeterminate render). Pinned both at the unit level (TestReadState_MultipleActiveSpecs_ReturnsNonNilIndeterminate, using exactly my probe's fixture shape — two epics with spec_num/spec_title metadata via SetListJSONForTest) and end-to-end (TestPreCommit_MultipleActiveSpecs_BlocksOnProtectedBranch driving the real Run wiring to Block). COMMENT-VS-FLOW VERIFICATION, claim by claim: (1) 'Two distinct Context shapes reach here with an empty Phase ... never a third, undiscovered one' — verified against derive.go: WorktreeSpec/WorktreeBead cannot produce an empty Phase (round-1's unconditional ModeSpec/ModeImplement backfills, re-confirmed), WorktreeMain's len==1 arm copies ActiveSpec.Phase which comes from DerivePhaseWithCache/DerivePhaseFromChildren, and I checked DerivePhaseFromChildren returns only non-empty modes — so the only empty-Phase producers really are the error arm (DerivationFailed) and the uncovered len>1 ambiguity arm. And even if a third shape were ever introduced, the predicate is TOTAL over empty Phase, so the invariant degrades to catching it as indeterminate rather than to a nil bypass — the comment's enumeration is accurate AND not load-bearing, the right way round. (2) ''no state' is reachable ONLY via the two genuinely-pre-initialization checks above — never here' — now true: I additionally verified phase.ResolveContext can NEVER return a non-nil error (filepath.Abs failure is swallowed to ".", and ResolveContextFromDirWithCache's only return is `ctx, nil`), so the `ctxErr == nil && ctx != nil` guard always enters and no error-path can leave hs zero-valued; combined with the total predicate, every post-initialization path yields a non-empty Mode. The round-4 false claims are gone. ALSO IN THIS COMMIT (round-4 G2/R6's ask, not mine, checked under my lens): runPreCommit gains an explicit fail-closed Block for spec/ branches when Mode == ModeIndeterminate — the sentinel previously fell through to the final Pass. Contract impact traced: bead/ branches and other non-spec non-protected branches still short-circuit Pass before state is read (autopilot/impl subagents unaffected); the new Block can fire for (a) a bd outage while committing on a spec/ branch (previously Pass via the fabricated backfill mode) and (b) a spec/ branch checked out in the MAIN worktree with 2+ active specs — both are deliberate fail-closed strengthenings in the honest direction, the Block message names the REAL cause (never claiming implement), and the MINDSPEC_ALLOW_MAIN escape hatch is honored at the top of runPreCommit and documented in the message for the legitimate final-review fix-up flow. No mishandling: the sentinel now has an explicit, honest disposition on every branch class. Tests: full internal/hook suite passes clean in the bead worktree. One wry empirical confirmation for the record: my first -v re-run exported MINDSPEC_ALLOW_MAIN=1 (my environment's global-hook workaround from prior rounds) into the test process and every Block-asserting test correctly flipped to Pass — the escape hatch demonstrably dominates all the new blocks, exactly as documented; the plain run without the variable is fully green. Worktree left byte-identical; no probe clones created this round.
